terms.name: Owner
terms.definition: The person authorized to manage the private workspace.

terms.name: Repository
terms.definition: A versioned collection of source material and its related work items.

terms.name: Inbox
terms.definition: The collection of synchronized issues and pull requests available for personal triage.

terms.name: Work item
terms.definition: An issue or pull request tracked in the private workspace.

terms.name: Agent run
terms.definition: Retained agent work with a task, workspace, conversation and lifecycle status.

terms.name: Work profile
terms.definition: Reusable task defaults, execution permissions and publishing authority.

terms.name: Skill
terms.definition: Named instructions selected as context for agent work.

terms.name: Prepared launch
terms.definition: A durable snapshot of proposed work settings awaiting an explicit start.

terms.name: Attention request
terms.definition: A question, approval or supported form response requested by an agent.

terms.name: Credential
terms.definition: A private value that authorizes access to a service.

terms.name: Priority
terms.definition: The urgency assigned to an item by local override, label mapping or background assessment.

terms.name: Relationship
terms.definition: A local or discovered reference connecting work items or ticket context.

terms.name: Subscription
terms.definition: A host registration for delivery of matching application events.

terms.name: Reconciliation
terms.definition: A reviewed decision about consistency among related contracts, implementation and assertions.

terms.name: Verification
terms.definition: Recorded execution of checks against identified inputs.

terms.name: Workspace
terms.definition: An isolated working checkout retained for an agent task.

terms.name: Transcript
terms.definition: The retained conversation, output and changes belonging to agent work.

terms.name: Host
terms.definition: The application presenting the connected private workspace.

terms.name: Glossary
terms.definition: The canonical vocabulary and meanings used to describe the application.

terms.name: UI entity
terms.definition: A named logical part of the visible interface.

terms.name: Widget type
terms.definition: A reusable control or display with a cohesive purpose.

terms.name: Widget instance
terms.definition: A displayed occurrence of a widget with its own local context.

terms.name: Pane
terms.definition: A group of controls or displays sharing a task or selected record.

terms.name: Page
terms.definition: A complete logical task surface.

terms.name: Dialog
terms.definition: A temporary task surface above a page.

terms.name: Shell
terms.definition: Shared identity, navigation, feedback and continuity around task surfaces.

terms.name: Named element
terms.definition: An individually named control, label, indicator or display field within a widget.

terms.name: Coverage gap
terms.definition: An identified shortfall in supported capability or evidence about behavior.

terms.name: Known limitation
terms.definition: An observed constraint or shortcoming in current behavior or operating conditions.

terms.name: Unverified behavior
terms.definition: Behavior whose claimed result has not yet been established by the required evidence.

terms.name: Keyboard focus
terms.definition: The interface element currently designated to receive keyboard input.

terms.name: Modal dialog
terms.definition: A dialog that restricts user interaction to its active task surface while open.

terms.name: New
terms.definition: An item discovered after the initial synchronization baseline and not yet acknowledged.

terms.name: Unread
terms.definition: An item with content changes beyond its last read revision.

terms.name: Acted on
terms.definition: An item with recorded personal action history independent of read and discovery status.

terms.name: Loading
terms.definition: Requested content is not yet available for display.

terms.name: Empty
terms.definition: The current collection has no records.

terms.name: Ready
terms.definition: Content is available for interaction.

terms.name: Error
terms.definition: An operation or content request has failed.

terms.name: Connected
terms.definition: The host connection is available.

terms.name: Disconnected
terms.definition: The host connection is unavailable or reconnecting.

terms.name: Pending
terms.definition: A decision, assessment or response has not yet resolved.

terms.name: Prepared
terms.definition: Work settings are retained for review before an explicit start.

terms.name: Queued
terms.definition: Explicitly started work is awaiting execution.

terms.name: Starting
terms.definition: A requested agent session is being initialized.

terms.name: Running
terms.definition: An agent turn is active.

terms.name: Waiting
terms.definition: An agent session is awaiting input or another required result.

terms.name: Idle
terms.definition: The current turn has finished and the retained session can receive follow-up.

terms.name: Interrupted
terms.definition: Active work has stopped with its session retained for continuation.

terms.name: Waiting for GitHub
terms.definition: Accepted work awaiting an automatic retry after temporary GitHub request-budget, quota-reserve or rate-limit unavailability, with its reason and earliest retry time retained.

terms.name: Failed
terms.definition: Work ended with an error and requires explicit recovery.

terms.name: Cleaned
terms.definition: The stopped working checkout has been removed while history remains retained.

terms.name: Blocking
terms.definition: A request requires a response before the agent can proceed.

terms.name: Continuing
terms.definition: A pending request permits the agent to keep working.

terms.name: Verified
terms.definition: A check has observed its required successful result.

terms.name: Unverified
terms.definition: A required result has not been established by observation.

terms.name: contains
terms.definition: Places a logical child within a task surface.

terms.name: selects
terms.definition: Changes which record or subset is displayed.

terms.name: navigates
terms.definition: Changes the active logical page.

terms.name: opens
terms.definition: Shows a temporary task surface.

terms.name: closes
terms.definition: Dismisses a temporary task surface.

terms.name: submits
terms.definition: Sends an explicit state change or response.

terms.name: refreshes
terms.definition: Supplies updated values to a display.

terms.name: references
terms.definition: Names a related domain record without implying navigation.

terms.name: external
terms.definition: Leaves the owned surface through an artifact, callback or host-mediated link.
